measurement.order: baseline/current on even zero-based repeats, reversed on odd repeats
measurement.scope: CPU eager fp32 NCHW sandbox simulation and normal Arena bookkeeping; seeded-random placements
measurement.replay_scope: separate untimed mirrored duels with full scoring
measurement.resource_note: CPU time includes all process threads. No process-RSS improvement is claimed.

limits: No cross-version or cross-device bitwise guarantee
Competing host processes and cgroup quota are not measured by this benchmark
No training, checkpoint writes, deterministic-policy changes, or simulation worker threads
